`SERVER_BASE_URL` in `frontend/lib/utils/constant.ts` is hard-coded to `https://conduit.productionready.io/api`. Out of the box, the frontend therefore calls the public Conduit API and not this Rust backend. It only reaches `get_user_profile` if you change that constant to point at the Rust server.
